recentItems.title: New reaction after Nvidia CEO resigns amid affairs and alleged spy scandal
recentItems.description:
Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia less than a week after reports about his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy rattled Wall Street and the White House, raising questions about the company’s future.

ABC News' Jay O'Brien has the latest.

recentItems.title: Start Here Nov. 13 | A Tech Titan's Downfall
recentItems.description: Nvidia’s CEO resigns after an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Police say a doctor has been identified as the gunman behind a deadly Washington, D.C. shooting. And a Microsoft Outlook outage stretches on for hours.

recentItems.title: Powerful Storms Batter East Coast. What You Need To Know - November 13
recentItems.description:
Hanna Battah reports on the storms rocking the East Coast, with tornadoes, damaging winds and large hail hitting the area. Plus, the shooting rampage at a gym in Washington, D.C., and the fallout after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned from the company. 

00:30: EXTREME WEATHER: A nor’easter is strengthening offshore toward the I-95 corridor, while waves reaching up to 50 feet are expected along the Northern California coast.
01:03: NVIDIA LATEST: CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a spy scandal following reports of at least two affairs.
01:46: LUTNICK TO TESTIFY: Lawmakers want to know whether advanced chips were diverted to China by companies buying from Nvidia.
02:03: D.C. GYM SHOOTING: Police say the shooting rampage stemmed from a dispute over a condo.
02:49: BROOKLYN COLLAPSE: Officials say eight people lost their lives, including two children.
03:14: HEGSETH HONORS ARMY: The defense secretary honored the young soldier who reprimanded him at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
03:49: MICROSOFT OUTAGE: Microsoft scrambled to fix a widespread outage affecting millions.
04:21: TRASHED PANDA: A raccoon that broke into a liquor store helped raise nearly $300,000.
04:50: REESE'S 3-POUND PIE: The oversized peanut butter cup has returned.
05:10: LIGHTSABER SELLS: Darth Vader's lightsaber sold at auction for nearly $5 million.
05:27: STAR WARS 50TH ANNIVERSARY: Disney is kicking off a year-long celebration to mark the 50th anniversary of a galaxy far, far away.

recentItems.title: Investigation into deadly building collapse begins
recentItems.description:
Eight people are dead, including two children, and over a dozen others injured after a three-story building collapsed into an open construction site in Brooklyn, according to New York City authorities.

Firefighters and police officers spent nearly 24 hours sifting through debris at the construction site in a "dangerous" search-and-rescue operation, fire officials said. Rescue operations concluded Thursday afternoon, after authorities determined there were no more victims, the FDNY said.
